hypotheses.persona: Construction/field worker with a regular 9-5 schedule
hypotheses.rationale: Early morning departure pattern consistent (05:09 on Day 0, 04:55 on Day 1, 05:12 on Day 2) with work badge, thermos, keys, laptop and phone. Return pattern also consistent (18:22 on Day 0, 18:24 on Day 1, 18:33 on Day 2). Hi-vis vest observation strongly supports field work hypothesis. Midday returns on all three days suggest lunch break at home.

hypotheses.persona: Shift worker with early morning shift
hypotheses.rationale: Early departure pattern could support shift work, but consistent return times suggest regular schedule rather than shift pattern. Midday returns don't align with typical shift worker patterns.

hypotheses.persona: Remote worker with occasional office visits
hypotheses.rationale: Laptop being taken to work and returned midday suggests occasional office visits, but early departure pattern with work badge and hi-vis vest points more strongly to field work.
